name: Delicious Sweet Scoops
desc: An assortment of ice cream scoops. Silky and dense, each scoop dissolves gracefully on the palate, giving way to a crisp, refreshing sweetness that gently blankets the senses. Even long after the carton is empty, you find yourself reluctant to put it down, closing your eyes to savor the lingering aftertaste of pure bliss...

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 320 and CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
